# Generator provenance

This directory is the compiled `dist/src` output of repository commit
`b03a226f1810ba7229583dc486751937eafc16aa`.

It is vendored because the public npm tarball tagged `1.4.1` predates the
German booklet exports used by this app. The code is generated from the same
TypeScript source as the original runtime generator; it is not a second
implementation.
